guia.titulo: How to set up billing with Lemon Squeezy
pasos: In Lemon Squeezy, create the subscription products: Starter, Agency and Agency Pro, each with a monthly and a yearly variant, at the landing page prices. Custom isn't sold here: it's set up by hand with the client.
For Live mode: in Lemon, with Test mode off, go to Settings → API → create a key. Paste it in the "Live" block and click Connect. If the account has several stores, also type the store id.
Check the plans: Clipfine suggests which variant is each plan by name and interval (month or year). Fix anything wrong or missing and click Save plans. All six need a variant.
Click Create webhook. It's created in Lemon pointing to this server, with a new secret. Without a webhook, Clipfine doesn't hear about payments or cancellations.
When the block says "Ready to charge", that mode can charge.
Repeat steps 2 to 4 in the "Test" block, with Test mode on in Lemon. Test mode products are separate: create them there too (or copy them with Copy to test mode).

Test a payment: in Subscriptions, mark one of your accounts with Test billing. Sign in with that account at /plan, choose a plan and pay with the test card 4242 4242 4242 4242 (any future date and CVC). Check that the plan and hours change.
importante: Each mode has its own key: one with Test mode off (Live) and one with Test mode on (Test). If you swap them, Connect fails or the plans don't show up.
Accounts are charged in Live mode except those marked with Test billing in Subscriptions. That switch can't change while the account has an active subscription.
To charge for real, Lemon Squeezy has to activate (approve) the store. Lemon charges in its own name and handles taxes.
Redoing the webhook creates a new one with another secret and deletes the old one. Only do it if the webhook stopped working or the server address changed.
Keys are stored encrypted and never shown again (only the last 4). If the server's encryption key (FACEBOOK_TOKEN_KEY) is lost, paste them again.
What you set here wins over the server variables (.env).
Only the account owner sees /plan. The app has no payment button (Apple and Google rules): payment happens on the web.
